google_live_session.apk_auth_pattern: Google Credential Manager for sign-in; Google AuthorizationClient for Google-account data authorization; OAuth authorization-code/PKCE where an installed-app flow is required
google_live_session.refresh_token_storage: avoid_when_possible; otherwise hardware-backed Android Keystore envelope and revocable account grant
google_live_session.id_token: identity assertion only; validate issuer, audience, expiry and nonce before trust
google_live_session.access_token: short-lived bearer credential; never log, commit or place in WebView DOM/localStorage

tls.trust: platform trust store or explicitly provisioned enterprise CA
tls.certificate_pinning: optional only with rotation and recovery plan
tls.mtls: preferred for private machine-to-machine administration when remote control is eventually enabled
tls.webview: packaged appassets origin remains network-dark unless a separately approved typed HTTPS client is added

keys.android_release_signing: persistent external trust anchor; never in repository or pull-request code
keys.candidate_signing: disposable debug key allowed only for side-by-side test package
keys.oauth_client_secret: not applicable to native public client; never embed one
keys.vpn_private_key: device/managed VPN store or protected keystore; never repository
keys.public_keys: safe to distribute when bound to owner, purpose, algorithm, fingerprint and rotation metadata
keys.rotation: document key id, creation, expiry/rotation trigger, revocation and recovery

vpn.purpose: optional remote administrative overlay only; loopback KAI/Ollama does not require VPN
vpn.preferred_android_owner: platform/managed VPN profile or dedicated audited OpenVPN client

openvpn.tls_crypt: prefer tls-crypt-v2 when server/client support it; per-client material preferred over one shared fleet key

vpn.termux: not a substitute for Android device-owner networking authority

green_semantics.source_green: static contracts and deterministic scans pass
green_semantics.connector_green: live authorized connector works without token extraction and destination visibility is verified
green_semantics.enterprise_green: also requires branch protections/ruleset, persistent signing custody, OAuth client registration/verification where used, and live TLS/VPN endpoint proof if those lanes are activated
green_semantics.device_runtime_green: requires physical Samsung install and runtime receipts

source_law: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI or deterministic probes prove. Human promotes.
